title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor

suppliers.sup:70510: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.subject: part:350011 Motor IE3 7.5 kW - 2027 pricing, request for pricing committee review
messages.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for your offer for part:350011. We value our long partnership and want a stable, fair basis for 2027.

Our forecast fc:350011@2026-09 records an 11.9 % volume increase for this motor.
Your scorecard sc:70510@2026Q3 shows on-time delivery of 90.4 %.
The same scorecard sc:70510@2026Q3 records 273 ppm, above your standard 250 ppm commitment.

The attached term sheets cover 6110 pcs per year over 12 months, from 2027-01-01. One option offers longer payment terms if that helps your financing. Since the requested change exceeds 2 %, could you please submit our proposal to your pricing committee for an authorized review?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Re: part:350011 Motor IE3 7.5 kW - 2027 pricing, request for pricing committee review
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We can accept your terms and await your order. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. However, the substantial increases in our raw material and labor costs prevent us from meeting your proposed price levels. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

Our offer stands at a price of €359.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
